00046 DiskInUGenInternal::DiskInUGenInternal(AudioFileID audioFile, 
00047                      AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, 
00048                      const bool loopFlag, 
00049                      const double startTime,
00050                      const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00051 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, format.mChannelsPerFrame - 1),
00052   audioFile_(audioFile),
00053   numChannels_(format.mChannelsPerFrame),
00054   loopFlag_(loopFlag),
00055   startTime_(startTime),
00056   packetCount(0),
00057   currentPacket(0),
00058   allocatedBlockSize(0),
00059   audioData(0),
00060   numPackets(0),
00061   bytesPerFrame(format.mBytesPerFrame),
00062   fileSampleRate(format.mSampleRate),
00063   reciprocalSampleRate(1.0/fileSampleRate),
00064   doneAction_(doneAction),
00065   shouldDeleteValue(doneAction_ == UGen::DeleteWhenDone)
00066 {
00067   OSStatus result;
00068   UInt32 dataSize;
00069   
00070   if(audioFile_)
00071   {
00072     dataSize = sizeof(packetCount);
00073     result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyAudioDataPacketCount, &dataSize, &packetCount);
00074     if (result != noErr) 
00075     {
00076       printf("DiskIn: error: Could not get packet count: ID=%p err=%d\n", audioFile_, (int)result);
00077       AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00078       audioFile_ = 0;
00079     } 
00080     else
00081     {
00082       currentPacket = ugen::max(0.0, startTime) * fileSampleRate;
00083       if(currentPacket >= packetCount)
00084         currentPacket = 0;
00085       
00086       allocatedBlockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00087       audioData = malloc(bytesPerFrame * allocatedBlockSize);
00088     }
00089   }
00090 }

00092 DiskInUGenInternal::~DiskInUGenInternal() throw()
00093 {
00094   if(audioFile_)
00095     AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00096   
00097   free(audioData);
00098 }

00100 OSStatus DiskInUGenInternal::clearOutputsAndReadData(bool& shouldDelete) throw()
00101 {
00102   const int outputBlockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00103   const double sampeRateRatio = 1.0;//fileSampleRate * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00104   
00105   const int inputBlockSize = outputBlockSize * sampeRateRatio;
00106   
00107   if(inputBlockSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00108   {
00109     allocatedBlockSize = inputBlockSize;
00110     audioData = realloc(audioData, bytesPerFrame * allocatedBlockSize);
00111     if(!audioData)
00112     {
00113       printf("DiskIn: error: could not allocated memory for the new buffer size\n\n");
00114       AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00115       audioFile_ = 0;
00116     }
00117   }
00118   
00119   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00120   {
00121     float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00122     memset(outputSamples, 0, outputBlockSize * sizeof(float));
00123   } 
00124   
00125   if(!audioFile_)
00126   {
00127     numPackets = 0;
00128     return -1;
00129   }
00130   else
00131   {
00132     numPackets = inputBlockSize;
00133     UInt32 numBytesRead = -1;
00134     OSStatus result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile_, false,
00135                          &numBytesRead, NULL, 
00136                          currentPacket, &numPackets, audioData); 
00137     
00138     if(result == noErr)
00139     {  
00140       currentPacket += numPackets;
00141       
00142       if(numPackets < inputBlockSize)
00143       {
00144         if(loopFlag_)
00145         {
00146           // we hit the end of the file and looping is on, we need to pull 
00147           // a few samples from the start of the file
00148           
00149           const int remainingPackets = inputBlockSize - numPackets;
00150           
00151           unsigned char *remainingAudioData = (unsigned char*)audioData;
00152           remainingAudioData += remainingPackets * bytesPerFrame;
00153           
00154           numPackets = remainingPackets;
00155           result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile_, false, 
00156                           &numBytesRead, NULL, 
00157                           0, &numPackets, audioData);
00158           
00159           if(result == noErr)
00160           { 
00161             currentPacket = remainingPackets;
00162           }
00163         }
00164         else
00165         {
00166           if(shouldDeleteValue)
00167             setIsDone();
00168           
00169           shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00170         }
00171       }
00172     }
00173     
00174     return result;
00175   }
00176   
00177 }

00201 DiskInUGenInternalWav16::DiskInUGenInternalWav16(AudioFileID audioFile, 
00202                          AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, 
00203                          const bool loopFlag,

00210 void DiskInUGenInternalWav16::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00211 {
00212   static const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00213   
00214   if(clearOutputsAndReadData(shouldDelete) == noErr)
00215   {   
00216     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00217     {
00218       float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00219       SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00220       int numSamplesToProcess = numPackets;
00221       
00222       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00223       {
00224         *outputSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00225         outputSamples++;
00226         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00227       }
00228     }
00229   } 
00230 }

00457 void DiskIn::initWithAudioFile(const char* audioFilePath, 
00458                  const bool loopFlag, 
00459                  const double startTime,
00460                  const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00461 {
00462   Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00463   
00464   if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00465   { 
00466     path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Bundle, audioFilePath);
00467     audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00468   }
00469   
00470   OSStatus result;
00471   UInt32 dataSize;
00472   
00473   CFURLRef audioFileURL;
00474   audioFileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL,
00475                                (const UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00476                                strlen(audioFilePath), 
00477                                false);
00478   
00479   AudioFileID audioFile = 0;
00480   result = AudioFileOpenURL (audioFileURL, kAudioFileReadPermission, 0, &audioFile);
00481   CFRelease(audioFileURL);
00482   if (result != noErr) 
00483   {
00484     printf("DiskIn: error: Could not open file: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00485     audioFile = 0;
00486   }
00487   
00488   if(audioFile)
00489   {
00490     AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00491     dataSize = sizeof(format);
00492     result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyDataFormat, &dataSize, &format);
00493     if (result != noErr) 
00494     {
00495       printf("DiskIn: error: Could not get data format: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00496       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00497       audioFile = 0;
00498     }
00499     else if(format.mFormatID != kAudioFormatLinearPCM)
00500     {
00501       printf("DiskIn: error: Only PCM formats supported\\n");
00502       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00503       audioFile = 0;
00504     }
00505     else
00506     {
00507       if(format.mSampleRate != UGen::getSampleRate())
00508       {
00509         printf("DiskIn: warning: Sample rate mismatch - resampling is not yet implemented\\n");
00510       }
00511       
00512       if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat) != 0)
00513       {
00514         initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00515         
00516         if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00517         {
00518           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalFloatBigEndian(audioFile, 
00519                                         format, 
00520                                         loopFlag, 
00521                                         startTime, 
00522                                         doneAction));
00523           return;
00524         }
00525         else
00526         {
00527           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalFloatLittleEndian(audioFile, 
00528                                            format, 
00529                                            loopFlag, 
00530                                            startTime, 
00531                                            doneAction));
00532           return;
00533         }
00534       }
00535       else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00536       {
00537         // aif and other big edian?
00538         if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00539         {
00540           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00541           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff16(audioFile, 
00542                                     format, 
00543                                     loopFlag, 
00544                                     startTime, 
00545                                     doneAction));
00546           return;
00547         }
00548         else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00549         {
00550           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00551           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff32(audioFile, 
00552                                     format, 
00553                                     loopFlag, 
00554                                     startTime, 
00555                                     doneAction));     
00556           return;
00557         }
00558         else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00559         {
00560           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00561           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff24(audioFile, 
00562                                     format, 
00563                                     loopFlag, 
00564                                     startTime, 
00565                                     doneAction)); 
00566           return;
00567         }
00568         else
00569         {
00570           printf("DiskIn: error: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00571           AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00572           audioFile = 0;
00573         }
00574       }
00575       else
00576       {
00577         // wav and other little edian?
00578         if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00579         {
00580           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00581           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav16(audioFile, 
00582                                      format, 
00583                                      loopFlag, 
00584                                      startTime, 
00585                                      doneAction));
00586           return;         
00587         }
00588         else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00589         {
00590           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00591           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav32(audioFile, 
00592                                      format, 
00593                                      loopFlag, 
00594                                      startTime, 
00595                                      doneAction));
00596           return;         
00597         }
00598         else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00599         {
00600           initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00601           generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav24(audioFile, 
00602                                      format, 
00603                                      loopFlag, 
00604                                      startTime, 
00605                                      doneAction));
00606           return;         
00607         }
00608         else
00609         {
00610           printf("DiskIn: error: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00611           AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00612           audioFile = 0;
00613         }
00614       }
00615     }
00616   }
